title: Victoria Mansion

services.name: Guided Tour
services.desc: All of our tours are facilitated by trained docents. Depending on the day, tours may be guided OR self-paced; please call if you are interested in finding out which experience is offered on a particular day. Victoria Mansion is a much-loved Portland landmark, but its significance extends far beyond Maine. Distinguished for its architecture and extraordinary original interiors, it is among the most important homes of the 19th century anywhere in the nation. As an organization, it is our mission to conserve, maintain, and restore this one-of-a-kind property and share its history with the public.
